newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X rebounds despite rating downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X rebounds despite rating downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Bre-X Minerals Ltd rebounded partly on Monday after the gold prospector defended the accuracy of assay results and resource calculations for the Busang gold discovery in Indonesia.
Bre-X was up 0.50 at 15.70 on midday turnover of 4.2 million shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange, topping actives. On Nasdaq, Bre-X was up 3/8 at 11-3/8.
Shares in the Calgary-based gold prospector hit a 52-week low of 14.25 in Toronto on Friday, depressed by an Indonesian newspaper report that questioned the size and viability of the deposit.

"The company's board of directors has absolute confidence in the integrity and accuracy of assay results and resource calculations reported by the company for the Busang gold find since inception of exploration in 1993," Bre-X Chief Executive David Walsh said in a statement on Monday.
"Unfortunately, when the first ounce of gold is poured at Busang, I am sure the naysayers will complain about the color," Walsh said.
A New York-based investment firm downgraded its rating on Bre-X's stock today. Lehman Brothers lowered its rating to neutral from outperform.

The downgrade was prompted by "the uncertainty created by the combination of last week's apparent suicide of chief geologist Michael de Guzman and the mysterious press report that Freeport's (Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc ) due diligence is not going well," analyst Daniel McConvey said in a report.

Freeport has a 15 percent stake in Busang and is conducting a due diligence process on the site before developing a mine. Freeport has said it will not comment until the due diligence was completed. Bre-X has a 45 percent stake in Busang, and Indonesian interests 40 percent.
"There is still a lot of uncertainty. What we need is something hard and concrete," a Canadian mining analyst said on Monday.
The analyst said the focus of attention was now on the contracts of work for the Busang site, which Bre-X has said would be signed before the end of March.
